title: Field Guide to Zombie Memes
object: Saddle-stitched pocket guide, 4.5 x 7 in, 96 pages, two-colour interior, 40 species plates.
wall_label: Organized by behaviour, not nostalgia. Each species entry gives habitat, diet, predators, and undead rating on a five-skull scale. The guide names no real person and reproduces no photograph. Species are described the way a birder describes a bird, which turns out to be the correct register for this material.

notes.Sample entry: Reactio perpetua, the Perpetual Reaction. Habitat: reply chains, quote-tweets, any thread past forty comments. Diet: sincerity. Predators: none observed. Undead rating: four skulls. Notes: does not require the original post to survive. Has been documented feeding on posts that were deleted years earlier.
